records.authority: Nature reporting supplies the dated consortium announcement and its stated evaluation limits.
passages: The reported consortium fine-tuned OpenFold3 on 20,167 proprietary protein-ligand structures from five companies.
Nature reports a 1,056-structure held-out evaluation, says the model is not public, and says the described study has not been peer reviewed.
records.limitation: This is reporting on an unavailable, unreviewed research model. It establishes neither a new drug nor patient benefit.
